artifact_policy: Retain the exact 64 generated prompts and oracle answers, raw greedy completions, strict parse/exact-match results, model/data/code hashes, runtime/resource record, snapshots, and manifest. Do not retain model weights or hidden states. The 64-row pilot cohort is permanently excluded from any formal training or evaluation study.
claim_boundary: This is a train-only feasibility check of one cached base model on a small generated arithmetic pilot. It is not a training experiment, held-out result, preference-learning result, capability claim, or evidence about human preference.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA and MPS are forbidden

data.selection: All 64 rows generated from four declared four-operand integer expression compositions, 16 rows each. Operand derivation is SHA-256 based and retained in the generator. No benchmark/dataset or held-out cohort is used. Do not use these prompts for formal train, development, or confirmation data.

decision.interpretation: PASS means only that this fixed model/task/prompt/parser yields enough valid, non-ceiling base rollouts to justify designing a separate formal study. FAIL means do not train or open any future confirmation cohort under this task design. No gate may be relaxed after outputs are inspected.

generation.prompt_template:
Evaluate the fully parenthesized integer expression. Output exactly one line in this format: FINAL: <integer>
Expression: {expression}
generation.response_parser: Full-match exactly `FINAL: <optional minus><one or more decimal digits>` with surrounding whitespace only; all extra prose, additional numbers, commas, or missing marker are unparsed and incorrect.

purpose: Determine whether a frozen cached instruction model produces enough strictly parsed correct and incorrect base rollouts on generated compositional arithmetic tasks to justify a separately frozen DPO-versus-matched-SFT task-outcome study.
